map.输入各测段高差观测值及测站数（或距离），按测站数比例分配闭合差，计算平差后高差。: Enter the observed height differences of each section and the number of setups (or distance), distribute the misclosure in proportion to setups, and compute the adjusted height differences.
map.容许闭合差：平地 ±12√K mm（K 为公里数），山地 ±4√n mm: Allowable misclosure: flat terrain ±12√K mm (K in km), mountainous ±4√n mm
map.逐段累加得总里程（km）。: Accumulate each segment to get total mileage (km).
map.多段折线总长核算。: Total length check of a multi-segment polyline.
map.各段 1200+850+950+1000=4000 m → 总距=4000/10: Segments 1200+850+950+1000 = 4000 m → total distance = 4000/1000 = 4.0 km, used as the route mileage and fuel-estimate basis.
map.与各段坐标反算边长之和对比，差大查漏段或重复计。: Compare with the sum of coordinate-inverse side lengths of each segment; a large difference means a missing or duplicated segment.
map.和坐标距区别？: How does it differ from coordinate distance?
map.坐标距是两点直线（弦），路线累加是沿路折线（弧），后者更长更贴近实际里程。: Coordinate distance is the straight line (chord) between two points, while route accumulation follows the road polyline (arc) and is longer and closer to actual mileage.
map.统一 m 后 ÷1000 得 km，避免混用 ft/m 致里程错。: Unify to m then ÷1000 for km, to avoid mixing ft/m and misstating mileage.
